provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-2.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

roles.on: the focusable element, usually a text input

attributes.name: aria-valuenow
attributes.note: Not a required state of the role in WAI-ARIA 1.2, but required by the pattern page.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.values: IDREF of the visible label; otherwise aria-label

attributes.name: aria-invalid
attributes.note: When the value is outside the allowed range.

keyboard.action: Set the minimum, if there is one.
Set the maximum, if there is one.
Increase by a larger step than ArrowUp.
Decrease by a larger step than ArrowDown.
When the field is directly editable: type in the text box; characters that cannot be part of a value are ignored. Standard single-line editing keys are left to the browser.

focus.entry: Focus stays on the text field throughout; the increment and decrement buttons are not tab stops.

data.notes: Not direction-sensitive: there are no horizontal bindings, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the editable field belong to the caret. Home and End conflict with caret movement in an editable field; libraries differ on whether they set min/max there. Arabic: the field must accept Arabic-Indic (U+0660..0669) and Extended Arabic-Indic (U+06F0..06F9) digits and the Arabic decimal and thousands separators as input whatever digits it displays; that parsing is the number layer's job.
